about: A field for a color. A person types a hex value, or opens a panel and drags across an area of saturation and brightness, along a hue and an alpha slider, or presses a preset swatch. The trigger is named by the label and the color, and a hidden input submits the color with a form.

brand.label: Brand color
brand.pick: Pick a color from the screen

channelled.about: One slider and one number input per channel of the format in force. The segment group switches the controlled format, and each format's view shows its own channels, so a slider never reads a channel the color does not have.
channelled.title: Channel by channel

inline.about: With inline the panel renders in place, always open, without the shadow and the layer of a floating panel. The value swatch previews the color beside the hex input.
inline.title: Always on the page

primary.help: White text reads at {{ratio}}:1 on this color.
primary.label: Primary button color
primary.low: White text needs 4.5:1. Pick a darker color.

size.about: The sizes a field passes down. The hex input and the trigger are controls of the same size, so a color picker, a select and an input of one size line up in a form. The swatches grow with the size, and the area and the sliders keep theirs.
size.title: Sizes

stated.about: A disabled picker dims and takes no focus. A read-only picker takes focus and opens nothing. An invalid picker takes the error edge on its input and its trigger.
stated.title: Disabled, read-only and invalid

status.about: The status sets the edge and the focus ring of the hex input and the trigger from its palette, the same as a text field's.
status.title: Statuses

swatches.about: A picker of swatches alone, for a color from a fixed set. Each swatch is a toggle button named by its color, and the group takes the picker's label.
swatches.title: Swatches alone

title: Color picker

validated.about: Inside a field the picker takes the field's label, texts and invalid state, and a form receives the color in the format in force. Save a light color to see the contrast error.
validated.title: In a validated field

valued.about: A trigger with the swatch and the hex of the color, and no text input. The panel opens with its start on the trigger's start. onValueChange reports every step of a drag, and onValueChangeEnd reports where it stops.
valued.title: A trigger that shows its value

variant.about: The three field looks of the theme on the hex input and the trigger, the same as a text field's and a select's.
variant.title: Looks
